title: Visitor Arrival to James Madison's Montpelier
summary: A revised entrance to James Madison's Montpelier, closer in character to the eighteenth-century approach and suited to buses and heavy visitation.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. That page gives the location as Madison, VA; Montpelier is in Orange County, and the firm should confirm the line. The client, the year and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Conceptual and schematic design for revised entrance to historic Montpelier estate. New entrance is both more in character with 18th century arrival to estate and better suited for contemporary bus and high visitation traffic. Project directed by Arthur Bartenstein while Senior Landscape Architect with Hill Studio.
